name: 67214 · Wichita, KS
findings: ZIP 67214 (Wichita) has 108 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 67214 (Wichita) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
49% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 67214 (Wichita) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.0 times the typical level).
